entries.title: A second click on a Tasks row opens its task
entries.body: When you click a task waiting on you and then quickly click another task in Tasks, the second task now opens. The card you asked for first still comes forward, and a click or key you begin while it appears now does what you meant.
entries.noPicture: A still picture cannot show a click that used to do nothing; the Tasks panel and the card look the same before and after.
